AUTHOR: Christensen
TITLE: Detection, localization and classification of fish and fish species in poor conditions using convolutional neural networks
REGION: Training: Danish public aquaria (Esbjerg); field test: Weser river (Bremen) and Baltic Sea off Rügen, Germany
SPECIES: Atlantic herring, Atlantic mackerel, 'other species' catch-all class
DATA: Own data: 13,124 annotated aquarium images (3 campaigns, 4,593 fish); own at-sea test set (97 fish, Weser + Baltic)
V_EV: Sec V: 'The visibility in the water is at best 30-40 cm and the low-light conditions introduce extensive motion blur.'
D2: Aquarium train/eval split not described; final model adds 17 manually chosen sea images to training, rest of 97-fish sea set held out
D_EV: Sec V: 'The 17 samples are not included in the evaluation set and have been manually chosen to have minimum correlation with the evaluation set.'
R_EV: Sec V: 'Given that OFDNet has been trained on good condition aquarium data ... it obtains a 0.21 mAP' (vs aquarium mAP 0.55, Sec III)
E_EV: Sec III: 'The fully trained OFDNet is evaluated using the metrics of mean average precision (mAP)'
METR: mAP, per-class AP, % fish detected, % detected fish correctly classified
NOTE: INCL: training imagery is aquarium (P4), but in-situ at-sea results (Weser/Baltic) are reported separately, so INCL=Y per Clarification 6. V: visibility 'at best 30-40 cm' is an approximate stated value, not a measured index; coded 기타 정량 (alt: 정성 서술만 - V_ALL stays P either way). V6=P: aquarium (good) vs murky sea performance compared, but strata are qualitative and confounded with domain. D: aquarium train/eval split unit never stated; headline (abstract) result is the retrained model where 17 sea images were moved to training and manually chosen for minimum correlation with the evaluation set -> image-level, non-random; coded D1 image-level + D4=Y -> P (low confidence; a verifier may prefer D1=NR -> D_ALL=NR). R: aquarium-trained model tested at sea (different water condition, site, illumination) with numbers for both -> R_ALL=Y; note the external set is tiny (97 fish). C: confidences shown in Fig. 5 but no threshold value reported. E4: 'detects 66.7% of the fish' is a recall figure; not coded as FNR (lower-information choice). PRE: ImageNet then COCO; coded COCO (final detector pretraining).
